description: Fly Dragons through your own neighborhood or explore a viking version of the real world.  Dragons Adventure: World Explorer is an innovative gaming experience which transforms the real world into the fantastic world of How to Train Your Dragon 2. Help Hiccup and Toothless rescue captured dragons from evil dragon trappers by completing quests around the globe, then soar over familiar landmarks and roads in your own neighborhood by taking the game on the go. Intuitive gyro controls let you experience the thrill of flight. Will you learn how to train YOUR dragon?
